Exemplar Schools: Impact & Recovery
• The goal of the project is to utilize results from Hawaii SBA assessment to find
 outlier schools that we think have a high probability of being able to teach us
 something about beneficial and not-to-beneficial activities associated with impact
 and recovery.
• We focus on identifying three types of schools:
 • Large Impact/Large Recovery
 • Large Impact/Poor Recovery
 • Minimal Impact/Large Recovery
• We show an original figure and an updated figure after we revised the
 methodology on what SGP to use in 2022 to calculate academic recovery.
• The relationship between impact and recovery at the school level is negligible.
